Map tiles and address lookup for the Timesheet week map.

Tiles: https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
© OpenStreetMap contributors
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Tile usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/

Address lookup (only when a site has a saved address and no coordinates):
https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/
Nominatim usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
This app sends at most one request per second, sends a User-Agent and Referer
identifying Neill Data Timesheet (https://www.neilldata.com/timesheet/), and
caches every result so an address is looked up once.

Leaflet, which draws the on-screen map, is BSD-2-Clause. See vendor/leaflet/LICENSE.
No GPL code is included.
